description: This file defines a Java Swing component 'UpDownImage' used for rendering an individual engine report visualization, including waveforms, revolutions, and signal indicators in a UI panel.

classes.name: UpDownImage
classes.description: A custom Swing JPanel component that visualizes engine report data, including waveform graphics, revolution markers, and signal properties, with interactive mouse features.

methods.name: setSignalBody
methods.description: Sets the color of the signal's body (fill color in the waveform).

methods.name: setSignalBorder
methods.description: Sets the color of the signal's border.

methods.name: setToolTip
methods.description: Configures the tooltip text showing channel name and physical pin.

methods.name: setZoomProvider
methods.description: Placeholder for setting zoom functionality, currently empty.

methods.name: createTranslator
methods.description: Creates a coordinate translator translating time to screen pixels and vice versa.

methods.name: setWaveReport
methods.description: Sets the engine report data to be visualized and triggers repaint.

methods.name: propagateDwellIntoSensor
methods.description: Updates the sensor's value with the latest duration from engine report data.

methods.name: paint
methods.description: Overridden method for custom rendering of waveform, revolution markers, and tooltip information.

methods.name: drawStartOfRevolution
methods.description: Draws vertical lines indicating revolution start points based on revolution log data.

methods.name: isShowTdcLabel
methods.description: Indicates whether to show TDC (top-dead-center) labels on revolution lines. Defaults to false.

methods.name: paintScaleLines
methods.description: Draws periodic scale lines on the time axis if the waveform is not too dense.

methods.name: paintUpDown
methods.description: Render a visual segment indicating engine on/off cycles, with timing and angle info.

methods.name: setPhysicalPin
methods.description: Sets and updates the physical pin label and tooltip.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the UpDownImage object.
